name: Lava Bridge
description: A narrow stone crossing over lava channels, with dangerous edges and heat shimmer.

powers.name: Erupting Fissure
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A 2×2 square section of the bridge cracks. Each creature in the area takes 2d6 fire damage and is pushed 1 square toward the nearest edge. The squares become difficult terrain.
powers.recharge: Recharges when no creature is in the area

powers.name: Heat Shimmer
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn on the bridge
powers.effect: The creature grants combat advantage until the start of its next turn as heat distortion warps line of sight.

name: Ruined Pillars
description: Broken columns and scattered masonry create cover and difficult terrain.

powers.name: Collapsing Pillar
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: One pillar (GM's choice) collapses. Each creature adjacent to it must succeed on a DC 15 Reflex save or take 1d10 damage and be knocked prone. The pillar's square becomes difficult terrain providing superior cover.

powers.name: Shifting Rubble
powers.trigger: A creature uses a push, pull, or slide effect
powers.effect: The target is pushed 1 additional square as loose stone shifts underfoot.

name: Graveyard Fog
description: Heavy fog obscures lines of sight and makes movement harder to predict.

powers.name: Grasping Mist
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The fog thickens in a burst 2 centered on a random square. Creatures in the area are slowed until the end of their next turn. Undead in the area gain +2 to attack rolls instead.

powers.name: Spectral Whispers
powers.trigger: A living creature starts its turn in the fog
powers.effect: The creature takes a −2 penalty to Will defense until the start of its next turn as ghostly voices erode resolve.

name: Dragon Lair
description: A vast cavern littered with bones and treasure, with elevated ledges for aerial attacks.

powers.name: Treasure Avalanche
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A hoard pile shifts. Each creature in a burst 1 (GM places) takes 1d8 damage and is knocked prone (DC 15 Reflex negates the prone condition). The squares become difficult terrain.

powers.name: Elevated Strike Zone
powers.trigger: A creature attacks from 2+ squares higher than its target
powers.effect: The attack deals 1d6 extra damage as the elevated position provides devastating advantage.

name: Frozen Lake
description: Cracked ice over dark water. The surface is slippery and sections may break under weight.

powers.name: Cracking Ice
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A 3×3 square section cracks. Creatures in the area must succeed on a DC 14 Acrobatics check or fall prone. On the next round, the section breaks — creatures still there fall into freezing water (2d6 cold damage, restrained until escape DC 15).
powers.recharge: Each section can only crack once

powers.name: Slippery Surface
powers.trigger: A creature charges or runs on the ice
powers.effect: The creature must succeed on a DC 12 Acrobatics check or slide 1d4 squares in its direction of movement past its target.

name: Feywild Glade
description: Luminescent mushrooms and twisting roots surround a misty clearing where reality shifts.

powers.name: Reality Warp
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Two random creatures swap positions (teleportation). Each is dazed until the end of its next turn as reality reorients.

powers.name: Luminescent Spores
powers.trigger: A creature moves more than 4 squares on its turn
powers.effect: Disturbed mushrooms release spores in a burst 1 around the creature's starting position. Creatures in the area cannot benefit from invisibility or concealment until end of next turn.

name: Demon Rift
description: A jagged tear in the ground leaks brimstone fumes and chaotic energy.

powers.name: Brimstone Eruption
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The rift spews energy. Each creature within 3 squares of the rift takes 1d8 fire and poison damage (DC 15 Fortitude for half).

powers.name: Chaotic Pull
powers.trigger: A creature is bloodied while within 5 squares of the rift
powers.effect: The rift pulls the creature 2 squares toward itself. If this moves the creature into the rift's square, it takes 2d8 damage.

name: Goblin Warrens
description: Cramped tunnels with pit traps, narrow choke points, and ambush alcoves.

powers.name: Hidden Pit Trap
powers.trigger: A creature enters a trapped square (GM places 1d4 traps at setup)
powers.effect: The floor gives way. The creature takes 1d10 damage and falls prone in a 10-foot pit (DC 15 Athletics to climb out).

powers.name: Tunnel Ambush
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A narrow tunnel (GM's choice) collapses to 1 square wide until cleared (DC 15 Athletics, standard action). Creatures inside take 1d6 damage.

name: Shadow Rift
description: Patches of darkness move on their own, and sounds echo from impossible directions.

powers.name: Creeping Darkness
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Darkness spreads. One random square and all squares within burst 1 become heavily obscured until the end of the next round.

powers.name: Echo Displacement
powers.trigger: A creature misses with a ranged attack
powers.effect: Sounds echo from impossible directions. The target of the attack can shift 1 square as a free action.

name: Storm Plateau
description: An exposed rocky plateau crackling with static. Metal objects attract bolts.

powers.name: Lightning Strike
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Lightning strikes a random creature wearing metal armor or holding a metal weapon. The creature takes 2d8 lightning damage (DC 15 Reflex for half). Each creature adjacent to the target takes 1d6 lightning damage.

powers.name: Static Buildup
powers.trigger: A creature scores a critical hit
powers.effect: Residual static arcs to the nearest creature within 3 squares, dealing 1d8 lightning damage.

name: Acid Cavern
description: Pools of caustic liquid dot the floor, and stalactites drip corrosive slime.

powers.name: Acid Geyser
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: An acid pool erupts in a burst 1 (GM places). Creatures in the area take 2d6 acid damage (DC 14 Reflex for half). The area becomes an acid zone until end of next round (entering or starting turn: 1d6 acid).

powers.name: Dripping Stalactite
powers.trigger: A creature takes acid damage
powers.effect: A caustic stalactite above destabilizes. At the start of the creature's next turn, it drips acid on the creature for 1d6 acid damage (DC 12 Reflex negates).

name: Beast Den
description: A natural cave strewn with bones and nests, with narrow escape tunnels.

powers.name: Cornered Beast Fury
powers.trigger: A beast is bloodied for the first time
powers.effect: The beast can immediately shift 2 squares and make a basic melee attack as a free action.

powers.name: Narrow Escape Tunnel
powers.trigger: A creature is adjacent to a tunnel entrance and uses a move action
powers.effect: The creature can squeeze through the narrow tunnel, emerging in a square of the GM's choice within 5 squares (counts as full move).

name: Giant Stronghold
description: Oversized furniture and crumbling walls create difficult terrain for small creatures.

powers.name: Hurled Furniture
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: An oversized piece of furniture shifts. One random Medium or smaller creature in the room must succeed on DC 14 Reflex or take 2d6 damage and be pushed 2 squares.

powers.name: Unstable Floor
powers.trigger: A Large or larger creature moves 3+ squares
powers.effect: The floor shakes. Each Small or Medium creature within 3 squares of the path must succeed on DC 12 Acrobatics or fall prone.

name: Poison Swamp
description: Murky water, venomous reeds, and toxic gas pockets make every step dangerous.

powers.name: Toxic Gas Pocket
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A gas pocket erupts in burst 2 (GM places). Creatures in the area take 1d8 poison damage and are weakened until end of next turn (DC 15 Fortitude negates the weakened condition).

powers.name: Sucking Mud
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in swamp water
powers.effect: The creature must spend 1 extra square of movement to leave its current square. If it cannot, it is immobilized until the end of its turn.

name: Celestial Ruins
description: Shattered marble halls glowing with fading divine radiance. Holy ground shifts allegiance.

powers.name: Divine Radiance Flare
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Fading divine energy pulses from a ruin fragment. Each undead or fiend creature within burst 3 takes 1d10 radiant damage. Each other creature in the area gains 5 temporary hit points.

powers.name: Shifting Allegiance
powers.trigger: A creature with a healing power uses it in the ruins
powers.effect: Holy ground resonates — the healing grants 1d6 additional hit points.

name: Shifting Maze
description: Walls rearrange themselves between rounds. Nothing stays where you last saw it.

powers.name: Walls Rearrange
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The maze shifts. Each creature must succeed on DC 14 Perception or lose line of sight to all other creatures until the end of its next turn. The GM may move one wall section up to 3 squares.

powers.name: False Passage
powers.trigger: A creature moves through a doorway or opening
powers.effect: Roll 1d6. On a 1-2, the doorway leads somewhere unexpected — the creature appears in a random opening within 6 squares instead.

name: Volcanic Vent
description: Geysers of flame erupt unpredictably. Sulfur clouds reduce visibility.

powers.name: Flame Geyser
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A vent erupts in burst 1 (GM places). Creatures in the area take 2d6 fire damage (DC 15 Reflex for half). The area becomes a fire zone for 1 round (entering or starting turn: 1d6 fire).

powers.name: Sulfur Cloud
powers.trigger: A creature takes fire damage from a terrain source
powers.effect: Choking fumes fill a burst 1 around the fire source. Creatures entering or starting their turn there take a −2 penalty to attack rolls (Fortitude DC 12 negates).

name: Abandoned Temple
description: Desecrated altars and shattered statues line the nave. Dark energy pools in the apse.

powers.name: Dark Energy Pulse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Necrotic energy surges from the desecrated altar. Each living creature within burst 3 of the altar takes 1d8 necrotic damage. Each undead creature in the area gains +1 to attack rolls until end of next round.

powers.name: Shattering Statue
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed or slid into a statue
powers.effect: The statue shatters. The creature takes 1d10 damage and each creature in burst 1 takes 1d6 damage from fragments. The square becomes difficult terrain.

name: Crystal Cavern
description: Razor-sharp crystal formations refract light into blinding patterns and create echoes.

powers.name: Prismatic Flash
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Crystals refract ambient energy. Each creature in the cavern must succeed on DC 14 Fortitude or be blinded until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Resonance Shatter
powers.trigger: A thunder or force power hits a crystal formation
powers.effect: The crystal explodes. Each creature within burst 1 of the crystal takes 2d6 damage. The crystal is destroyed.

name: Blood Rock
description: The site of ceremonial sacrifices or a great slaughter. Crimson stone that empowers those who spill blood nearby. (DMG p.67)

powers.name: Bloodfrenzy
powers.trigger: A creature is bloodied while on blood rock
powers.effect: The creature gains +1 to melee damage rolls until end of encounter but takes a −1 penalty to Will defense.

powers.name: Crimson Surge
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Blood rock pulses. Each bloodied creature on the rock takes 1d6 necrotic damage. Each non-bloodied creature on the rock gains 5 temporary hit points.

name: Cave Slime
description: Thin blue slime coating the floor. Harmless but extremely slick — creatures that move too fast risk falling. (DMG p.67)

powers.name: Slick Surface
powers.trigger: A creature charges or runs through cave slime
powers.effect: The creature must succeed on DC 14 Acrobatics or fall prone and slide 1d4 squares.

powers.name: Slime Splash
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed, pulled, or slid through a square of cave slime
powers.effect: The creature must succeed on a saving throw or fall prone. If the creature is already prone, it slides 1 additional square in the direction of the forced movement.

name: Choke Frost
description: Light, white mist that congeals into thick ice as creatures move through it, slowing and immobilizing. (DMG p.67)

powers.name: Frost Snap
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Choke frost congeals. Each creature in a frost square is slowed (save ends). A creature already slowed is immobilized instead (save ends).

powers.name: Ice Tomb
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn immobilized in choke frost
powers.effect: The creature is restrained (save ends). On a failed save, the creature is instead stunned (save ends).

name: Cloudspore
description: Strange Underdark mushrooms that release a thick cloud of choking spores when disturbed. (DMG p.67)

powers.name: Spore Cloud
powers.trigger: A creature enters or starts its turn in a cloudspore square
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 poison damage and is blinded until the start of its next turn (DC 14 Fortitude negates blindness).

powers.name: Spore Detonation
powers.trigger: A fire or lightning attack targets a square containing cloudspore
powers.effect: The cloudspore detonates. Close burst 2 from the cloudspore square; each creature in the burst takes 1d8 + half level damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. The cloudspore is destroyed.

name: Ember Moss
description: Strange Underdark moss that is highly flammable. Burns brightly when ignited, spreading fire rapidly. (DMG p.67)

powers.name: Moss Ignition
powers.trigger: A fire attack hits a square containing ember moss
powers.effect: The moss ignites in burst 2. Each creature in the area takes 2d6 fire damage. The area burns for 2 rounds (entering or starting turn: 1d6 fire). The moss is destroyed.

powers.name: Ember Trail
powers.trigger: A creature moves through burning ember moss
powers.effect: The creature leaves a trail of fire in each square it exits. Each square deals 5 fire damage to any creature entering or starting its turn there. The trail burns out at the end of the round.

name: Font of Power
description: Planar energy or a powerful artifact boosts attacks made from within this area. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Power Surge
powers.trigger: A creature uses an encounter or daily power while in the font
powers.effect: The power deals 1d6 extra damage or the creature gains +2 to the attack roll (creature's choice).

powers.name: Power Overload
powers.trigger: A creature uses a daily attack power while in the font
powers.effect: The attack deals 1d10 extra damage, but the creature takes 5 damage of the same type as the attack (or untyped if the attack has no damage type).

name: Grab Grass
description: Thick, tough grass of the deep Feywild forests that grasps at creatures, slowing movement. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Grasping Tendrils
powers.trigger: A creature enters a grab grass square
powers.effect: The creature is slowed until the start of its next turn. If already slowed, it is immobilized instead (DC 14 Athletics or Acrobatics to escape as a move action).

powers.name: Root Tangle
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone in grab grass
powers.effect: The creature is restrained (save ends). While restrained, the creature takes a −2 penalty to saving throws against this effect if it is in difficult terrain.

name: Grasping Slime
description: Black, viscous goo whose clingy surface can cause creatures to become stuck in place. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Sticky Grasp
powers.trigger: A creature enters a grasping slime square
powers.effect: The creature is immobilized (escape DC 15 Athletics). A creature that starts its turn immobilized by the slime takes 1d6 acid damage.

powers.name: Slime Coat
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn restrained by grasping slime
powers.effect: The creature takes ongoing 5 acid damage (save ends). While taking this ongoing damage, the creature grants combat advantage.

name: Mirror Crystal
description: Crystals that cause strange twists and turns in space — teleportation becomes unpredictable. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Spatial Twist
powers.trigger: A creature uses a teleport power within 3 squares of a mirror crystal
powers.effect: Roll 1d6. On 1-3, the destination shifts 1d4 squares in a random direction. On 4-6, the teleport works normally.

powers.name: Reflection Trap
powers.trigger: A ranged or area attack passes through a square of mirror crystal
powers.effect: The attacker rerolls the attack against one ally of their choice within 3 squares of the crystal, using the same attack roll. The ally becomes the secondary target.

name: Pillar of Life
description: A tall stone pillar infused with life energy. Creatures nearby heal faster but also attract attention. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Life Pulse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature within burst 2 of the pillar regains 5 hit points. Undead take 5 radiant damage instead.

powers.name: Revitalizing Burst
powers.trigger: A creature is reduced to 0 hit points or fewer within 2 squares of the pillar
powers.effect: The creature can spend a healing surge as a free action. This power then becomes inert until the end of the encounter.

name: Sacred Circle
description: A circle dedicated to a specific deity and infused with divine energy. Sacred ground that may aid or hinder. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Sacred Ward
powers.trigger: An undead or fiend enters the sacred circle
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d10 radiant damage and is pushed 1 square out of the circle.

powers.name: Divine Blessing
powers.trigger: A creature uses a healing power within the circle
powers.effect: The healing restores 1d6 additional hit points.

name: Spiderwebs
description: Thick webs of giant spiders fill an area, creating difficult terrain and potentially restraining creatures. (DMG p.69)

powers.name: Web Snare
powers.trigger: A creature enters a webbed square
powers.effect: The creature is restrained (escape DC 14 Athletics or Acrobatics, or destroy the web: AC 12, 15 HP, vulnerable 10 fire).

powers.name: Web Collapse
powers.trigger: A creature uses a fire attack in or adjacent to spiderwebs
powers.effect: The webs in a burst 2 centered on the target square burn away (no longer difficult terrain), and each creature in the burst takes 1d6 fire damage. Any creature restrained by webs is freed.

name: Whirlwind
description: Whirlwinds form where elemental energy is strong. They slide creatures around and disrupt ranged attacks. (DMG p.69)

powers.name: Gust Blast
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The whirlwind slides each creature within burst 2 of its center 1d4 squares in a random direction. Ranged attacks through the whirlwind take a −2 penalty until end of next round.

powers.name: Vortex Lift
powers.trigger: A creature enters the whirlwind's space
powers.effect: The creature is lifted 4 squares into the air and suspended (save ends). While suspended, the creature cannot move except to shift, and falls when the effect ends.

name: Blast Cloud
description: Rust-hued dust particles that conduct and amplify energy and elemental forces. Attacks within deal extra damage. (DMG2 p.58)

powers.name: Energy Amplification
powers.trigger: A creature uses a power with fire, lightning, or thunder keyword while in the cloud
powers.effect: The power deals 1d8 extra damage of that type.

powers.name: Chain Reaction
powers.trigger: An attack with a fire, lightning, or thunder keyword hits a creature in blast cloud
powers.effect: The attack deals 1d6 extra damage of the triggering type, and each creature adjacent to the target takes 5 damage of the same type.

name: Blood Midge Cloud
description: A swarm of biting insects that harass creatures moving through the area. (DMG2 p.58)

powers.name: Midge Frenzy
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature starts its turn in the cloud
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d8 damage and grants combat advantage until end of its next turn as midges swarm the wound.

powers.name: Midge Swarm Redirect
powers.trigger: A creature takes damage while in the blood midge cloud
powers.effect: The midges swarm toward the wounded creature. Until the end of the creature's next turn, it takes a −2 penalty to attack rolls and the cloud moves up to 3 squares toward the creature.

name: Bolt Stone
description: Lightning energy fused with rock forming a highly unstable, dangerous mixture that arcs when struck. (DMG2 p.58)

powers.name: Arc Discharge
powers.trigger: A creature strikes bolt stone with a melee weapon
powers.effect: Lightning arcs to the attacker and each creature adjacent to the bolt stone, dealing 1d8 lightning damage (DC 14 Reflex for half).

powers.name: Bolt Stone Ruin
powers.trigger: A creature with an available power uses a Standard Action within 10 squares
powers.effect: Arcana check (hard DC). On success, the bolt stone explodes: burst 1 centered on the stone; Level + 3 vs. Reflex; hit: normal high lightning damage and push 1; miss: half damage. The bolt stone is destroyed.

name: Creeping Ice
description: Areas infused with cold energy that slowly drain living creatures of warmth and vitality. (DMG2 p.58)

powers.name: Frostbite Aura
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on creeping ice
powers.effect: The creature takes 5 cold damage. If the creature doesn't move at least 2 squares on its turn, it is slowed until end of next turn.

powers.name: Flash Freeze
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The ice expands by 1 square in each direction. Any creature in a newly frozen square is immobilized (save ends). The DC to escape the ice increases by 2 each round.
powers.recharge: Recharges when a creature breaks free of the ice

name: Defiled Ground
description: The dead do not always rest in peace. Necrotic energy seeps from the earth, empowering undead. (DMG2 p.59)

powers.name: Necrotic Empowerment
powers.trigger: An undead creature starts its turn on defiled ground
powers.effect: The undead regains 5 hit points and gains +1 to attack rolls until end of its turn.

powers.name: Life Drain
powers.trigger: A living creature is bloodied while on defiled ground
powers.effect: The creature takes ongoing 5 necrotic damage (save ends).

name: Doomlight Crystal
description: Glowing rock formations trapping volatile gas that explodes violently on contact with air. (DMG2 p.59)

powers.name: Volatile Detonation
powers.trigger: A doomlight crystal takes any damage
powers.effect: It explodes: burst 2, 2d8 damage to each creature in the area (DC 15 Reflex for half). Crystal is destroyed.

powers.name: Sympathetic Resonance
powers.trigger: A doomlight crystal detonates
powers.effect: Each other doomlight crystal within 5 squares pulses. Creatures adjacent to any pulsing crystal take 1d6 radiant damage and are dazed until the end of their next turn.

name: Fey Circle
description: A location empowered with extraordinary Feywild energy. Teleportation and illusion magic intensifies. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Fey Warp
powers.trigger: A creature uses a teleport power within the fey circle
powers.effect: The distance of the teleport increases by 2 squares. The creature gains concealment until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Fey Banishment
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed into the fey circle's space
powers.effect: The creature vanishes into the Feywild for 1 round, reappearing in the same square at the start of its next turn. While banished, the creature cannot act or be targeted.

name: Grasping Bog
description: An area of deep, viscous mud that hampers movement and can pull creatures under. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Quicksand Pull
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the bog
powers.effect: DC 14 Athletics check or the creature sinks — slowed on first failure, immobilized on second, restrained on third. Each escape requires a standard action (DC 14 Athletics).

powers.name: Drowning Bog
powers.trigger: Standard Action; an enemy must be prone in adjacent grasping bog
powers.effect: Athletics check vs. enemy's Athletics. On success, the grasping bog's restrained effect worsens: first failed save: dazed (save ends); second failed save: unconscious (save ends); third failed save: dead.

name: Infernal Fumes
description: Great clouds of gray smoke that drift as if alive, choking and blinding those within. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Choking Cloud
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the fumes
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 fire and poison damage and cannot use immediate actions until end of its turn (DC 14 Fortitude negates the action restriction).

powers.name: Fume Ignition
powers.trigger: A fire attack is used in or adjacent to infernal fumes
powers.effect: The fumes ignite in a burst 2. Each creature in the burst takes 2d6 fire damage and is pushed 1 square. The fumes dissipate from the affected squares for 1 round.

name: Jade Flame
description: Strange, vibrant green fire that burns everything near yet protects from other heat sources. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Green Fire Shield
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in jade flame
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 fire damage but gains resist 5 fire from other sources until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Emerald Aegis
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in jade flame and is bloodied
powers.effect: The creature gains resist 5 all until the end of its next turn, but takes 5 fire damage.

name: Necrotic Ground
description: An area infused with necrotic energy that drains life from the living and empowers the dead. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Death's Grasp
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each living creature on necrotic ground takes 1d6 necrotic damage. Each undead creature on it gains +2 to damage rolls until end of next round.

powers.name: Animate Dead
powers.trigger: A creature dies on necrotic ground
powers.effect: At the start of the next round, a zombie minion (level equal to the dead creature) rises in that square under the GM's control. It acts on initiative count 0.

name: Needle Hedge
description: Sharp-needled bushes from the dark forests of the Shadowfell that slash at creatures passing through. (DMG2 p.61)

powers.name: Thorn Slash
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed or pulled through a needle hedge square
powers.effect: The creature takes 2d6 damage and ongoing 5 damage (save ends) from embedded thorns.

powers.name: Thorny Retaliation
powers.trigger: A creature forces another creature through needle hedge squares
powers.effect: The forced creature takes 1d6 + half level damage per square of needle hedge moved through, and ongoing 5 poison damage (save ends).

name: Phase Mist
description: A hazy cloud of swirling color connected to the spaces between planes. Creatures may phase in and out. (DMG2 p.61)

powers.name: Phase Flicker
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in phase mist
powers.effect: Roll 1d6. On 1-2, the creature is phased (insubstantial and can move through solid objects) until end of its turn.

powers.name: Plane Slip
powers.trigger: A creature teleports while in phase mist
powers.effect: The teleportation destination is shifted 1d4 squares in a random direction. If the new square is occupied or impassable, the creature appears in the nearest safe square and is dazed until the end of its next turn.

name: Rage Stone
description: Black-veined crimson stone infused with psychic residue of brutal atrocities. Drives creatures to fury. (DMG2 p.61)

powers.name: Fury Surge
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on rage stone
powers.effect: The creature gains +2 to melee damage rolls until end of its turn but must make a melee basic attack on its turn if able (takes 1d8 psychic damage if it doesn't).

powers.name: Berserk Feedback
powers.trigger: A creature hits with a melee attack while adjacent to rage stone
powers.effect: The creature must make a saving throw. On failure, the creature must use its next standard action to make a melee basic attack against the nearest creature (ally or enemy).

name: Thunder Shards
description: Crystalline shards of solidified thunder energy. Unstable and dangerous — they detonate when disturbed. (DMG2 p.61)

powers.name: Shard Detonation
powers.trigger: A creature moves into a thunder shard square
powers.effect: The shard detonates: burst 1, 2d6 thunder damage (DC 14 Reflex for half). Each creature damaged is also deafened (save ends). The shard is destroyed.

powers.name: Resonant Chain
powers.trigger: A thunder shard detonates
powers.effect: The sound wave triggers adjacent shards. Each creature within 2 squares of the chain takes 1d8 thunder damage and is knocked prone. All triggered shards are destroyed.

name: Haunted Terrain
description: This terrain radiates negative emotions — vague unease to crippling sorrow to virulent hatred of life. (Open Grave p.29)

powers.name: Haunting Dread
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each living creature in the area takes a −2 penalty to Will defense and cannot willingly move closer to the center of the haunted zone until end of next round (DC 15 Will negates).

powers.name: Manifestation
powers.trigger: A creature drops to 0 HP in the haunted area
powers.effect: A spectral echo appears in the fallen creature's square — the echo grants combat advantage to enemies and has 1 HP. It vanishes at end of next round.

name: Razorvine
description: A hardy creeper with serrated leaves sharp enough to shred flesh. Ubiquitous throughout the planes. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Razor Lash
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed, pulled, or slid through razorvine
powers.effect: The creature takes 2d6 damage and ongoing 5 damage (save ends).

powers.name: Entangling Creep
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in razorvine
powers.effect: The creature is slowed until end of its turn unless it succeeds on DC 14 Athletics.

name: Dungeon Corridor
description: A wide stone hallway with alcoves, side doors, and a collapsed section creating a bottleneck.

powers.name: Ceiling Collapse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10 (once per encounter)
powers.effect: A 2×2 section of ceiling collapses (GM places in the corridor). Each creature beneath takes 2d6 damage (DC 14 Reflex for half). The squares become blocking terrain.

powers.name: Bottleneck
powers.trigger: Two or more creatures end their turns in the collapsed section
powers.effect: Creatures in the bottleneck grant combat advantage to enemies outside it.

name: Open Clearing
description: A broad clearing with sparse boulders for cover and uneven ground slowing movement.

powers.name: Exposed Ground
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn more than 3 squares from any cover
powers.effect: Ranged attacks against the creature gain +1 to attack rolls until the creature moves to cover.

powers.name: Flanking Rush
powers.trigger: A creature charges while starting in the clearing
powers.effect: The creature gains +1 to the attack roll if the charge line passes through open ground (no difficult terrain). If the creature is hidden, it does not provoke opportunity attacks during this charge.

name: Forest Road
description: A dirt path through dense trees. Undergrowth creates difficult terrain off the road.

powers.name: Falling Branch
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A heavy branch falls in a random 2×1 area. Each creature underneath takes 1d10 damage and is knocked prone (DC 14 Reflex negates). The branch creates difficult terrain.

powers.name: Ambush Cover
powers.trigger: A hidden creature attacks from off-road undergrowth
powers.effect: The attacker gains +2 to the attack roll and can shift 1 square into the undergrowth after the attack as a free action, maintaining concealment.

name: Underground River
description: A natural cavern bisected by a fast-flowing river. Stepping stones offer risky crossings.

powers.name: River Surge
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The river's current intensifies. Any creature in the water is pushed 3 squares downstream. Creatures on stepping stones must succeed on DC 14 Acrobatics or fall in.

powers.name: Current Drag
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn in the river
powers.effect: The current slides the creature 2 squares downstream. If the creature is prone, it slides 3 squares instead and must succeed on a saving throw or be submerged (dazed until it surfaces as a move action).

name: Ruined Bridge
description: A half-collapsed stone bridge over a deep chasm. Gaps force jumps or careful climbing.

powers.name: Crumbling Section
powers.trigger: Two or more creatures stand on the same bridge section (3×1 area)
powers.effect: The section collapses. Each creature falls 20 feet (2d10 falling damage) unless it succeeds on DC 15 Acrobatics to grab the edge.

powers.name: Desperate Leap
powers.trigger: A creature attempts to jump a gap in the bridge
powers.effect: Athletics check (moderate DC). On success, the creature clears the gap. On failure by 5 or more, the creature falls. On failure by less than 5, the creature catches the edge and can pull up as a move action, but provokes opportunity attacks.

name: Tavern Interior
description: Overturned tables, a long bar, and a staircase to a balcony. Tight quarters with improvised cover.

powers.name: Overturned Table Cover
powers.trigger: A creature uses a move action to flip a table
powers.effect: The table provides superior cover (+5 AC) in one direction until destroyed (AC 4, 20 HP). A creature can kick the table — push it 2 squares as a standard action.

powers.name: Chandelier Drop
powers.trigger: A creature uses a standard action to cut the chandelier rope
powers.effect: The chandelier crashes: burst 1 under it, 2d6 damage (DC 14 Reflex for half) and the area is lit on fire (entering: 1d6 fire, 2 rounds).

name: Marketplace
description: Vendor stalls, crates, and awnings create a maze of cover and narrow lanes.

powers.name: Toppling Stall
powers.trigger: A Large creature moves through a market stall
powers.effect: The stall collapses: burst 1, creatures take 1d6 damage and fall prone (DC 12 Reflex negates). The area becomes difficult terrain.

powers.name: Crowd Chaos
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10 (first round only)
powers.effect: Panicked civilians flee. Each creature not adjacent to a wall is pushed 1 square in a random direction and grants combat advantage until end of next turn.

name: Clifftop Camp
description: A campsite on a rocky ledge. One side drops away steeply — forced movement is deadly.

powers.name: Cliff Edge
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed to within 1 square of the cliff edge
powers.effect: DC 15 Acrobatics or the creature goes over. It can grab the edge (DC 12 Athletics) or fall, taking 5d10 damage.

powers.name: Loose Stones
powers.trigger: A creature within 2 squares of the cliff edge is hit by a push or slide effect
powers.effect: The forced movement increases by 1 square. If this forces the creature over the edge, the creature can make a saving throw to catch the ledge instead of falling.

name: Flooded Cellar
description: Knee-deep water slows movement. Pillars support a low ceiling. Barrels float as unstable platforms.

powers.name: Barrel Platform
powers.trigger: A creature jumps onto a floating barrel (move action, DC 12 Acrobatics)
powers.effect: The barrel provides a dry platform but is unstable — if the creature is hit by an attack, DC 14 Acrobatics to stay on or fall prone in the water.

powers.name: Water Surge
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Water sloshes. Each creature in the cellar is slid 1 square toward the room's lowest point.

name: Canyon Pass
description: A narrow ravine with high walls on both sides. Enemies above have superior positioning.

powers.name: Rockfall
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Rocks tumble from the canyon walls. Each creature in a random 3×1 area takes 2d6 damage (DC 14 Reflex for half) and the area becomes difficult terrain.

powers.name: High Ground Advantage
powers.trigger: A creature on the canyon rim attacks a creature on the canyon floor
powers.effect: The attack gains +2 to hit and +1d6 damage as the height advantage is extreme.

name: Crumbling Tower
description: A multi-level ruin with holes in the floors, a spiral stair, and precarious ledges.

powers.name: Floor Collapse
powers.trigger: A creature uses a power that deals thunder, force, or more than 15 damage in the tower
powers.effect: Roll 1d6. On 1-2, a 2×2 floor section collapses. Creatures on it fall one level (1d10 damage, prone). The hole persists.

powers.name: Cascading Debris
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed through a wall or into a support pillar
powers.effect: Burst 1 centered on the impact point; each creature in the area takes 1d8 damage and the affected squares become difficult terrain. If a floor section loses its support, creatures above must succeed on a saving throw or fall to the level below.

name: Winding Staircase
description: A spiral staircase with landings at different levels. Height advantage and tight corners define the fight.

powers.name: Tumble Down
powers.trigger: A creature on the stairs is knocked prone
powers.effect: The creature tumbles 1d4 landings downward, taking 1d6 damage per landing. Other creatures in the path must succeed on DC 12 Reflex or be knocked prone.

powers.name: Stair Tumble
powers.trigger: A creature on the stairs is knocked prone or pushed downhill
powers.effect: The creature tumbles 1d4 squares down the staircase, taking 1d6 damage per square tumbled, and lands prone. Creatures in the path must succeed on a Reflex save or also be knocked prone.

name: City Rooftops
description: Flat rooftops of varying heights connected by narrow planks. Falls to the streets below are lethal.

powers.name: Plank Bridge
powers.trigger: A creature moves across a connecting plank
powers.effect: DC 12 Acrobatics or the creature falls to the streets below (varies, typically 3d10 damage). The plank can be kicked away as a minor action.

powers.name: Loose Tiles
powers.trigger: A creature charges on a rooftop
powers.effect: DC 14 Acrobatics or the creature falls prone as tiles slide. The tiles scatter into the square below: creatures underneath take 1d6 damage.

name: Muddy Riverbank
description: Soft ground along a river. Movement is hampered near the water, but the current offers escape routes.

powers.name: Sucking Mud
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn in the mud
powers.effect: DC 12 Athletics or the creature is slowed until end of its next turn.

powers.name: River Pull
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone within 1 square of the river
powers.effect: The creature slides 1 square toward the river. If this moves the creature into the water, it must use a move action on its next turn to swim back or be carried 2 squares downstream.

name: Abandoned Mine
description: Timber-braced tunnels with minecart tracks, rubble piles for cover, and risk-of-collapse choke points.

powers.name: Minecart Launch
powers.trigger: A creature uses a standard action to push a minecart
powers.effect: The cart rolls 6 squares in a straight line along the track. Each creature in its path takes 2d6 damage and is pushed 1 square to the side (DC 14 Reflex to jump aside: no damage).

powers.name: Support Beam Collapse
powers.trigger: A support beam is destroyed (AC 4, 25 HP)
powers.effect: The ceiling collapses in a 3×3 area: 2d10 damage (DC 15 Reflex for half). The area becomes blocking terrain.

name: Ancient Library
description: Towering shelves of books create corridors. Ladders offer height. Toppling shelves can block or crush.

powers.name: Toppling Bookshelf
powers.trigger: A creature uses a standard action to push a bookshelf
powers.effect: The shelf topples in a 1×3 line. Each creature in the path takes 2d6 damage and is knocked prone (DC 14 Reflex: half damage, not prone). The area becomes difficult terrain.

powers.name: Arcane Tome
powers.trigger: A creature uses a minor action to search a bookshelf within reach
powers.effect: Arcana check (moderate DC). On success, the creature gains +2 to its next attack roll with an arcane power. On a critical success, the bonus is +4. The bookshelf can only be searched once.

name: Ship Deck
description: The rolling deck of a ship at sea. Masts, rigging, and rails create vertical terrain. Falling overboard is punishing.

powers.name: Rolling Deck
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The ship rolls. Each creature on deck is slid 2 squares toward the lower rail. DC 12 Acrobatics negates. Creatures hitting the rail take 1d6 damage.

powers.name: Rigging Swing
powers.trigger: A creature grabs rigging (move action, must be adjacent to a mast)
powers.effect: The creature swings up to 6 squares in a straight line, landing in any unoccupied square along the path. Does not provoke opportunity attacks.

name: Courtyard
description: A stone courtyard surrounded by walls with archer positions. A fountain or well at the center provides partial cover.

powers.name: Arrow Slit Volleys
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10 (if archers are positioned)
powers.effect: Arrows rain into the courtyard: burst 2 (centered on the courtyard), +12 vs. AC, 1d8+4 damage. Cover from the fountain provides +2 to defenses against this attack.

powers.name: Fountain Splash
powers.trigger: A creature pushes another creature into the fountain
powers.effect: The target is knocked prone and slowed (save ends) as it flounders in the water. The fountain square is difficult terrain.

name: Mountain Switchback
description: A narrow trail carved into a mountainside. The uphill side offers high ground; the downhill side, a long drop.

powers.name: Switchback Slide
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed off the uphill side of the trail
powers.effect: The creature slides 2d4 squares down the mountainside, taking 1d6 damage per 2 squares, landing prone. DC 14 Athletics to grab a handhold after 1d4 squares.

powers.name: Rockslide
powers.trigger: A creature on the uphill side uses a standard action to dislodge rocks
powers.effect: Athletics check (moderate DC). On success, a burst 1 area downhill becomes difficult terrain; each creature in the burst: Level + 3 vs. Reflex; hit: 1d10 damage and knocked prone.

name: Illusions
description: Illusions can mimic any terrain, tricking creatures into dangerous positions or hiding real hazards. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Illusory Terrain Shift
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: One 3×3 area of illusory terrain shifts location (GM places). Creatures who enter it believing it is real terrain: DC 15 Insight to disbelieve. Failing creatures treat it as difficult terrain and grant combat advantage.

powers.name: Illusory Double
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: One creature chosen by the GM gains an illusory duplicate in an adjacent square. Enemies attacking the creature must roll 1d6; on 1-3, they target the illusion instead and automatically miss. The illusion vanishes when targeted or at the start of the next round.

name: Illusory Wall
description: An illusory wall blocks line of sight but allows creatures to pass through. Enemies can hide behind it or ambush from within. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Ambush Passage
powers.trigger: A creature behind the illusory wall attacks through it
powers.effect: The attacker gains combat advantage and +2 to the attack roll. After the attack, the wall shimmers and is partially revealed (DC 10 Insight to see through it).

powers.name: Phantom Corridor
powers.trigger: A creature moves through the illusory wall for the first time
powers.effect: If the creature has not identified the wall as illusory (Arcana or Insight, moderate DC), it is dazed until the end of its next turn from disorientation.

name: Loadstone
description: This strange rock dramatically increases the weight of all objects near it, slowing movement and hampering flight. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Gravitational Pull
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn within 2 squares of the loadstone
powers.effect: The creature is pulled 1 square toward the loadstone and is slowed until end of its turn. Flying creatures are pulled 2 squares instead and must land if pulled adjacent.

powers.name: Crushing Weight
powers.trigger: A creature in heavy armor starts its turn adjacent to loadstone
powers.effect: The creature is slowed until the end of its next turn and takes a −2 penalty to Reflex defense. Creatures in light or no armor are unaffected.

name: Slides
description: A surface coated with a slick substance. Creatures that enter may slide uncontrollably in one direction. (DMG p.68)

powers.name: Slippery Slide
powers.trigger: A creature enters a slide square
powers.effect: The creature slides to the end of the slick surface, moving up to 6 squares in the slide's direction. It cannot stop until it reaches the end or hits an obstacle (1d6 damage to both).

powers.name: Momentum Crash
powers.trigger: A creature slides 3 or more squares along the slide
powers.effect: At the end of the slide, the creature may continue moving 1 additional square but takes 1d6 damage if it collides with a wall or another creature. The struck creature is also knocked prone.

name: Teleporters
description: Magical gates that whisk characters from one spot to another, disrupting positioning and enabling surprise flanks. (DMG p.69)

powers.name: Warp Gate
powers.trigger: A creature enters a teleporter square
powers.effect: The creature is teleported to the linked teleporter square. If unwilling, DC 14 Fortitude to resist. Creatures emerging from a teleporter are dazed until end of their next turn.

powers.name: Teleport Scramble
powers.trigger: Two or more creatures use the teleporter in the same round
powers.effect: Both creatures make a saving throw. On failure, their destinations are swapped. If both fail, they arrive dazed until the end of their next turn.

name: Dimensional Turbulence
description: Instability in the fabric of a plane making teleportation difficult and inaccurate. Teleporting creatures may end up in the wrong spot. (DMG2 p.59)

powers.name: Teleport Scatter
powers.trigger: A creature uses a teleport power in the area
powers.effect: The destination scatters 1d4 squares in a random direction. If the new destination is occupied or solid, the teleport fails and the creature takes 1d8 force damage.

powers.name: Rift Snap
powers.trigger: A creature attempts to teleport within dimensional turbulence
powers.effect: If the creature fails the check to teleport accurately, a dimensional rift opens in its original square. Each creature within 2 squares is pulled 1 square toward the rift and takes 1d8 force damage.

name: Eldritch Influx
description: Magical energy pools in this area, flowing into the void left behind by the expenditure of magical item powers. Recharges spent abilities. (DMG2 p.59)

powers.name: Power Recharge
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the influx zone
powers.effect: The creature can recharge one expended encounter power (roll 1d6; recharges on 4+). Each creature can only benefit once per encounter.

powers.name: Arcane Feedback
powers.trigger: A creature expends an encounter or daily power while in the influx
powers.effect: The eldritch energy surges through the caster. The creature regains the use of one expended encounter power of its choice, but takes 1d10 psychic damage.

name: Elemental Windchurn
description: Elemental turbulence crackling with energy, its swirling winds making flying difficult and pushing creatures off course. (DMG2 p.59)

powers.name: Gale Force
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each flying creature in the area is pushed 2d4 squares in a random direction. Non-flying creatures in the area are pushed 1 square. Ranged attacks passing through take a −4 penalty.

powers.name: Updraft Launch
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn in the windchurn while flying
powers.effect: The creature is lifted 3 squares upward and pushed 2 squares in a random horizontal direction. It may make a saving throw to resist the horizontal push.

name: Energy Node
description: A particularly strong confluence of arcane, divine, or other forms of power. Boosts attacks or healing for those standing within. (DMG2 p.59)

powers.name: Energy Surge
powers.trigger: A creature uses a power with a damage roll while in the node
powers.effect: Add 1d6 extra damage of a random type (roll 1d4: 1=fire, 2=cold, 3=lightning, 4=thunder).

powers.name: Node Overcharge
powers.trigger: Three or more creatures occupy squares adjacent to the energy node simultaneously
powers.effect: The node discharges. Close burst 3; each creature in the burst takes 2d8 force damage and is pushed 2 squares. The node becomes inert for 1 round.

name: Healing Ground
description: An area infused with primal energy that allows life of all sorts to flourish. Creatures within regenerate hit points. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Regenerative Pulse
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on healing ground
powers.effect: The creature regains 5 hit points. A creature at full HP instead gains 5 temporary hit points.

powers.name: Primal Regrowth
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature starts its turn on healing ground
powers.effect: The creature regains hit points equal to its healing surge value divided by 4. Undead and constructs instead take 5 radiant damage.

name: Martyr's Monument
description: The life energy of an ancient and powerful champion of the gods, embodied in a statue or holy icon. Empowers divine abilities. (DMG2 p.60)

powers.name: Martyr's Blessing
powers.trigger: A creature uses a divine power within 3 squares of the monument
powers.effect: The creature gains +2 to the attack roll or the power restores 1d6 additional HP (creature's choice).

powers.name: Sacrificial Shield
powers.trigger: An ally within 3 squares of the monument is hit by an attack
powers.effect: As an immediate interrupt, a creature adjacent to the monument can take the damage instead. The monument then grants the protecting creature +2 to all defenses until the end of its next turn.

name: Quick Sear
description: A viscous, silvery green liquid resulting from the mixture of acid and quicksilver. Burns on contact and corrodes metal. (DMG2 p.61)

powers.name: Caustic Splash
powers.trigger: A creature enters a quick-sear pool
powers.effect: The creature takes 2d6 acid damage and takes ongoing 5 acid damage (save ends). Metal armor or weapons in contact take a cumulative −1 penalty to AC or attack rolls (save ends).

powers.name: Quicksear Lash
powers.trigger: Standard Action; must be within 5 squares of a patch of at least 4 squares; must have Force keyword power available
powers.effect: Arcana check (moderate DC). On success, attack one creature within 3 squares of the quick sear: Intelligence vs. Reflex; hit: medium limited damage (acid). Effect: Rearrange up to 4 squares of quick sear no more than 3 squares from their previous location.

name: Abyssal Wellspring
description: A suppurating wound in reality where the raw madness and evil of the Abyss bulges into another plane. (Manual of the Planes p.21)

powers.name: Madness Pulse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature within burst 3 of the wellspring makes a DC 15 Will save or makes a basic melee attack against the nearest creature as a free action.

powers.name: Abyssal Eruption
powers.trigger: A creature is bloodied within 3 squares of the wellspring
powers.effect: The wellspring pulses. Each creature within 2 squares of the wellspring takes 1d8 psychic damage and must make a saving throw or make a melee basic attack against the nearest creature as a free action.

name: Angelic Lantern
description: Small, pulsating balls of light that are faint manifestations of divine will. They illuminate and may aid the righteous. (Manual of the Planes p.21)

powers.name: Guiding Light
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn within 2 squares of a lantern
powers.effect: The creature gains +1 to attack rolls against undead and fiends until end of its turn.

powers.name: Blinding Radiance
powers.trigger: A creature attacks an ally of the lantern's creator while within the lantern's light
powers.effect: The lantern flares. The attacker takes 5 radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. Undead take 10 radiant damage instead.
powers.recharge: Recharges after one round without triggering

name: Astral Flame
description: A fountain of fiery liquid — the burning essence of the Astral Sea. Burns with otherworldly heat. (Manual of the Planes p.21)

powers.name: Astral Burn
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The flame erupts in burst 1. Each creature in the area takes 2d6 fire and radiant damage (DC 15 Reflex for half).

powers.name: Flame Vortex
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed or pulled into astral flame
powers.effect: The creature takes 2d6 fire damage and ongoing 5 fire damage (save ends). While taking this ongoing damage, the creature sheds bright light in a 2-square radius, negating concealment.

name: Divine Blood
description: Wreckage from the ancient war between the gods and primordials still litters the planes. Divine blood pools radiate power. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Divine Resonance
powers.trigger: A creature with a healing surge starts its turn in the blood pool
powers.effect: The creature can spend a healing surge as a free action but is dazed until end of its next turn as divine power overwhelms.

powers.name: Blood of Creation
powers.trigger: A creature spends a healing surge while standing on divine blood
powers.effect: The creature regains additional hit points equal to half its level and gains +2 to its next attack roll. The divine blood in that square is consumed.

name: Elemental Seepage
description: A strange, viscous mass pulsating with the energy of the Elemental Chaos — fire, cold, thunder, lightning, or a combination. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Random Energy Burst
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The seepage discharges in burst 2. Roll 1d4 for damage type (fire/cold/lightning/thunder). Each creature takes 2d6 damage of that type (DC 14 Reflex for half).

powers.name: Chaotic Mutation
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in elemental seepage for the third consecutive round
powers.effect: The creature gains one random benefit until the end of the encounter: resist 5 fire, +1 speed, or +2 to Fortitude. The GM rolls 1d6 to determine the effect.

name: Energy Crystals
description: Weird crystals that collect and store energy of all kinds. They discharge violently when disturbed. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Crystal Discharge
powers.trigger: A creature strikes a crystal with a melee attack
powers.effect: The crystal shatters: burst 1, 2d8 damage of a random energy type. Each creature in the area also takes ongoing 5 damage of that type (save ends).

powers.name: Crystal Overload
powers.trigger: An energy crystal absorbs damage from three or more attacks
powers.effect: The crystal shatters. Close burst 2; each creature in the burst takes 2d8 damage of the type last absorbed and is knocked prone. The crystal is destroyed.

name: Erratic Portal
description: When the magic of a portal finally fails, it may transform into an erratic portal — flickering unpredictably between destinations. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Unstable Transit
powers.trigger: A creature enters or is pushed into the portal
powers.effect: Roll 1d6: 1-2 creature appears in a random square within 10; 3-4 creature is teleported to the GM's choice within 20 squares; 5-6 portal flickers and nothing happens.

powers.name: Planar Bleed
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The portal flickers and deposits a hazard from another plane in a random square within 3 squares: fire (1d8 fire damage, ongoing 5), ice (difficult terrain), or shadow (concealment). The effect lasts 1 round.

name: Hellfire
description: Fire found predominantly in the Nine Hells. Burns hotter than natural flame and sears the soul. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Hellfire Eruption
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Hellfire surges in burst 2 (GM places). Each creature takes 2d8 fire damage (DC 15 Reflex for half). Fire resistance is reduced by 5 against this damage.

powers.name: Soul Scorch
powers.trigger: A creature takes hellfire damage while bloodied
powers.effect: The creature cannot regain hit points until the end of its next turn. If the creature would be healed, it instead takes 5 fire damage.

name: Phase Rock
description: Phase rocks are slightly out of sync with reality. Creatures near them may phase in and out unpredictably. (Manual of the Planes p.22)

powers.name: Phasing Flicker
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on phase rock
powers.effect: Roll 1d6. On 1-2, the creature is phased until end of its turn (insubstantial, can move through walls). On 6, the creature is teleported 1d6 squares in a random direction.

powers.name: Phase Trap
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn within 1 square of phase rock
powers.effect: The creature must make a saving throw. On failure, one piece of equipment (GM's choice) phases out of existence for 1 round, rendering it unusable. Weapons return at the start of the creature's next turn.

name: Aberrant Structures
description: Desiccated, long-dead structures in ruins left over from Nihilath. Their alien geometry warps perception. (Underdark p.82)

powers.name: Warped Geometry
powers.trigger: A creature uses a ranged power while within the structures
powers.effect: The range changes by 1d4−2 squares (may increase or decrease). On a result of 0 or less, the attack targets a random creature within range instead.

powers.name: Alien Geometry
powers.trigger: A creature attempts to move more than 4 squares in a single turn within the structures
powers.effect: The creature must succeed on a Dungeoneering check (moderate DC) or its movement is redirected to a random adjacent square and the creature is dazed until the end of its next turn.

name: Blinkrock
description: Nondescript gray-black stone with texture similar to granite and the ability to warp space. Creatures on it may teleport unexpectedly. (Underdark p.65)

powers.name: Spatial Hiccup
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on blinkrock
powers.effect: Roll 1d6. On 1-2, the creature teleports 1d4 squares in a random direction. This does not provoke opportunity attacks.

powers.name: Blink Cascade
powers.trigger: A creature strikes blinkrock with a melee attack
powers.effect: The impact causes a chain of spatial disruptions. Each creature within 2 squares makes a saving throw; on failure, the creature is teleported 1d4 squares in a random direction.

name: Blood Grate
description: Hideous contraptions that revitalize fomorians and their allies with the blood of intruders. (Underdark p.103)

powers.name: Blood Harvest
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature starts its turn on the grate
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 necrotic damage. One fomorian or fey creature within 5 squares regains the same amount of HP.

powers.name: Blood Harvest Surge
powers.trigger: Two or more creatures are bloodied above the blood grate simultaneously
powers.effect: The grate channels the blood energy. Each fomorian or allied creature within 5 squares gains temporary hit points equal to the number of bloodied creatures × 5.

name: Brainmoss
description: Tissue seeded from living brains growing on cavern walls and floors. Picks up and retains strong emotional impressions, affecting the minds of living creatures. (Underdark p.83)

powers.name: Psychic Echo
powers.trigger: A creature takes psychic damage within 3 squares of brainmoss
powers.effect: The brainmoss amplifies the pain. Each creature within burst 1 of the moss takes 1d6 psychic damage.

powers.name: Emotional Surge
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: DC 15 Will save for each creature within 3 squares or the creature gains either +2 to attack (rage) or −2 to attack (despair), GM's choice, until end of next turn.

name: Caught Breath
description: Tinkling crystals of warm breath frozen in air. Fragile and beautiful, but they shatter into cutting shards when disturbed. (Underdark p.120)

powers.name: Breath Shatter
powers.trigger: A creature moves through caught breath crystals
powers.effect: Burst 1 around the square: 1d8 cold damage and the area becomes difficult terrain of sharp crystal fragments.

powers.name: Frozen Exhalation
powers.trigger: A creature uses a close blast or close burst attack near caught breath crystals
powers.effect: The attack's area is filled with suspended ice particles. The area becomes difficult terrain until the end of the next round, and creatures that enter take 5 cold damage.

name: Darkrock
description: Darkrock drinks in illumination, weakening the light and creating strange, unpredictable shadows. (Underdark p.14)

powers.name: Light Devourer
powers.trigger: A light source enters within 3 squares of darkrock
powers.effect: The light's radius is halved. Creatures relying on the light source grant combat advantage to creatures in the dark.

powers.name: Shadow Ambush
powers.trigger: A creature in dim light created by darkrock makes a Stealth check
powers.effect: The creature gains a +4 bonus to the Stealth check. If it becomes hidden, its next attack from hiding deals 1d6 extra damage.

name: Eye Unblinking
description: Magic weapons made from ritually enlarged evil eyes and nourished by the blood of wounded foes, which loose beams of arcane energy at invaders. (Underdark p.103)

powers.name: Arcane Beam
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The eye fires a beam: ranged 10, +15 vs. Reflex, 2d6+4 force damage. On hit, the target is also dazed until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Retinal Burn
powers.trigger: A creature meets the gaze of the Eye Unblinking and fails a Will save
powers.effect: The creature is stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature is instead dazed until the end of its next turn.

name: Glowstone
description: Glowstone provides patches of dim light that break up the darkness of the Underdark. (Underdark p.14)

powers.name: Dim Beacon
powers.trigger: A creature is hidden within 3 squares of glowstone
powers.effect: The creature's Stealth check takes a −2 penalty as faint luminescence undermines concealment.

powers.name: Light Pulse
powers.trigger: The glowstone is struck by a melee attack
powers.effect: The stone flares brightly. Each creature within 3 squares is blinded until the end of its next turn. Creatures with darkvision are instead dazzled (−2 to attack rolls) for the same duration.

name: Godrock
description: Where fragments of Torog's bones struck the earth, formations called godrock sprouted. They radiate lingering divine agony. (Underdark p.119)

powers.name: Agony Pulse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature within burst 2 of the godrock takes 1d6 psychic damage and is slowed until end of its next turn (DC 15 Will negates the slowed condition).

powers.name: Echo of Agony
powers.trigger: A creature is reduced to bloodied while touching godrock
powers.effect: The godrock channels Torog's suffering. Each creature within 3 squares takes 1d8 psychic damage and is immobilized until the end of its next turn.

name: Godsblood
description: The divine energy remaining within this godsblood temporarily supercharges natural healing, but at the cost of stamina and sanity. (Underdark p.102)

powers.name: Divine Healing Surge
powers.trigger: A creature drinks from or touches the godsblood
powers.effect: The creature regains hit points as if spending two healing surges but loses one healing surge and is dazed until end of next turn.

powers.name: Blood Offering
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature touches godsblood as a minor action
powers.effect: The creature may spend a healing surge but heals only half the normal amount. In exchange, the creature gains +2 to attack rolls until the end of its next turn. The godsblood in that square is consumed.

name: Godsdream
description: Energy remaining from Torog's passage through the Shallows provides certainty of one incredible blow against a foe, but hides everything beneath a filmy dream layer. (Underdark p.33)

powers.name: Prophetic Strike
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn within the godsdream area
powers.effect: The creature gains +4 to its next attack roll but takes −2 to all defenses until end of its turn as the dream demands focus.

powers.name: Prophetic Vision
powers.trigger: Initiative count 20 (first round only)
powers.effect: One creature chosen at random receives a flash of foresight. That creature gains a +5 bonus to its next attack roll or saving throw (its choice), which must be used before the end of the encounter.

name: Godsrage
description: An echo of Torog's ancient fury — a terrible and appalling anger that infects travelers with raging power. (Underdark p.64)

powers.name: Rage Infusion
powers.trigger: A creature takes damage while in the godsrage area
powers.effect: The creature gains +4 to its next melee damage roll but must charge or make a melee basic attack on its next turn if able.

powers.name: Fury Overload
powers.trigger: A creature affected by rage infusion scores a critical hit
powers.effect: The godsrage energy surges violently. The creature deals 2d6 extra damage on the critical hit but also takes 1d10 psychic damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn.

name: Ground Swarms
description: Masses of rats, beetles, tiny drakes, or other nuisance creatures that harass and distract anyone entering their territory. (Underdark p.100)

powers.name: Swarm Surge
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in a swarm square
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 damage and takes a −2 penalty to attack rolls until end of its turn as vermin crawl over it.

powers.name: Swarm Diversion
powers.trigger: A creature takes damage from ground swarms
powers.effect: The swarms scatter outward. Each creature adjacent to the damaged creature must make a saving throw or take 5 damage as the swarms flee through their spaces.

name: Hungry Void
description: Some places in the unending night below sap existence and unravel the threads of life. Creatures nearby feel their vitality drain. (Underdark p.120)

powers.name: Void Drain
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the hungry void
powers.effect: The creature loses a healing surge. If it has no healing surges, it takes 1d10 necrotic damage instead.

powers.name: Void Collapse
powers.trigger: A creature is reduced to 0 hit points within the hungry void
powers.effect: The void surges hungrily. Each creature within 2 squares is pulled 1 square toward the fallen creature's space. The space becomes heavily obscured for 1 round.

name: Insect Cloud
description: Swarms of flying, blood-drinking bugs searching for targets. They obscure vision and harass creatures. (Underdark p.100)

powers.name: Biting Swarm
powers.trigger: A creature enters or starts its turn in the insect cloud
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 damage, grants combat advantage, and takes a −2 penalty to ranged attack rolls until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Cloud Migration
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The cloud moves 1d4 squares toward the nearest bloodied creature. If it enters a creature's space, that creature takes 5 damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Lifedrinker Caverns
description: Strange, black-speckled lichen that feeds on nearby injuries, sapping life from wounded creatures. (Underdark p.64)

powers.name: Life Siphon
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature starts its turn in the area
powers.effect: The creature takes 5 necrotic damage. The lichen stores this — the next creature to start its turn in the area while bloodied takes 5 less damage.

powers.name: Lichen Bloom
powers.trigger: A creature is reduced to bloodied in the cavern
powers.effect: The lichen rapidly spreads to cover the creature's square and adjacent squares, creating difficult terrain. Each creature starting its turn in these squares takes 5 necrotic damage.
powers.recharge: Recharges when no bloodied creature is in the cavern

name: Living Stone
description: Rock formations that grow on their own, slowly reshaping the cavern and potentially trapping those who linger. (Underdark p.13)

powers.name: Stone Grasp
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn without moving at least 2 squares
powers.effect: The stone crawls up the creature's legs. DC 14 Athletics or the creature is immobilized (save ends). On second failed save, the creature is restrained instead.

powers.name: Stone Surge
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn on living stone
powers.effect: The stone shifts beneath it. The creature slides 1 square in a direction of the GM's choice. If this movement provokes opportunity attacks, the creature gains +2 to AC against them.

name: Mushroom Arch
description: A series of glowing mushrooms that grow together to form an arch over a corridor, shedding spores and dim light. (Underdark p.101)

powers.name: Spore Burst
powers.trigger: A creature moves through the mushroom arch
powers.effect: Burst 1 around the arch: creatures are blinded until end of their next turn (DC 12 Fortitude negates). The arch's light goes out for 1 round.

powers.name: Luminous Cascade
powers.trigger: A creature passes under the mushroom arch
powers.effect: Glowing spores shower down. The creature sheds dim light in a 2-square radius for 1 round and cannot benefit from concealment or stealth during that time. Shadow creatures also take 5 radiant damage.

name: Primal Mud
description: Organic sludge that forms where life force rises up through the Feydark into the Feywild. Teeming with nascent life. (Underdark p.101)

powers.name: Life Surge
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone in primal mud
powers.effect: Tiny creatures sprout and attack: the prone creature takes 1d8 damage and is dazed until it stands. If the creature is bloodied, it regains 5 HP as the mud's primal energy responds to weakness.

powers.name: Regenerative Mire
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature is prone in primal mud at the start of its turn
powers.effect: The creature regains hit points equal to its level. Undead and constructs instead sink deeper — they are slowed (save ends).

name: Soul Shard Clusters
description: Remnants of living creatures slain in the Shadowdark linger as soul shards — crystallized anguish that cuts body and spirit. (Underdark p.121)

powers.name: Soul Shred
powers.trigger: A creature enters a soul shard square
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d10 necrotic and psychic damage and must succeed on DC 14 Will or grant combat advantage until end of next turn.

powers.name: Soul Wail
powers.trigger: A soul shard cluster is destroyed or damaged
powers.effect: Close burst 3 from the cluster. Each living creature in the burst takes 1d8 psychic damage and is dazed until the end of its next turn as spectral screams rip through them.

name: Spore Field
description: Intoxicating spores that rapidly decompose organic matter. Creatures that breathe them in become disoriented. (Underdark p.109)

powers.name: Decomposition Cloud
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Spores burst in burst 2 (GM places). Creatures take 1d6 poison damage and are dazed until end of next turn (DC 14 Fortitude negates dazed). Organic equipment degrades: −1 to next damage roll.

powers.name: Hallucinogenic Burst
powers.trigger: A creature fails a saving throw against spore field effects
powers.effect: The creature is confused until the end of its next turn, treating all other creatures as enemies. On its turn, it attacks the nearest creature.

name: The Weeping Lady
description: The heart-wrenching sobs of a seemingly female voice haunt the Deeps, distracting and demoralizing those who hear her. (Underdark p.64)

powers.name: Sorrowful Wail
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature in the area must succeed on DC 15 Will or be immobilized until end of its next turn as grief overwhelms it. Creatures that save are slowed instead.

powers.name: Despairing Grasp
powers.trigger: A creature fails a saving throw against the Weeping Lady's wail
powers.effect: The creature is immobilized (save ends) as spectral hands rise from the ground to hold it. While immobilized, the creature takes a −2 penalty to Will defense.

name: Wormrock
description: Porous orange rock that is easy to dig through. Tunnels collapse readily, and the ground is unstable. (Underdark p.14)

powers.name: Collapse
powers.trigger: A creature uses a power that deals thunder or force damage in the area
powers.effect: Burst 1 around the target square: ceiling debris falls. 2d6 damage (DC 14 Reflex for half) and the area becomes difficult terrain.

powers.name: Tunnel Ambush
powers.trigger: A creature within 3 squares of wormrock begins its turn
powers.effect: The GM may have a Tiny or Small creature emerge from the porous rock. The emerging creature can make an attack of opportunity against one adjacent creature before withdrawing into the rock.

name: Acidic Mire
description: Seas of flesh-dissolving liquids bordered by shores of moors that churn with acid bubbling up from below. (The Plane Below p.12)

powers.name: Acid Geyser
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A geyser erupts in burst 1 (GM places). Each creature takes 2d6 acid damage (DC 14 Reflex for half). The area becomes an acid zone for 1 round.

powers.name: Mire Geyser
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed into the acidic mire
powers.effect: The impact sends up a geyser of acid. Each creature within 2 squares of the impact point takes 1d6 acid damage. The pushed creature takes an additional 1d6 acid damage.

name: Bonepowder Haze
description: Strange haze of fine white powder crackling with necrotic energy that saps the life force of creatures and empowers nearby undead. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: Necrotic Haze
powers.trigger: A living creature starts its turn in the haze
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d6 necrotic damage. An undead creature instead gains +1 to attack rolls until end of its turn.

powers.name: Choking Dust
powers.trigger: A creature runs or charges through bonepowder haze
powers.effect: The creature must succeed on an Endurance check (moderate DC) or lose its remaining movement and be dazed until the end of its next turn as it chokes on concentrated necrotic dust.

name: Chaos Breath
description: Powerful, unpredictable wind gusts that extend high into the atmosphere, hurling creatures and debris. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: Wind Blast
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature in the area is pushed 1d6 squares in a random direction. Flying creatures are pushed double distance.

powers.name: Wind Wall
powers.trigger: A creature attempts a ranged attack through chaos breath
powers.effect: The attack takes a −4 penalty to the attack roll as the winds deflect projectiles. If the attack misses, the projectile is hurled 1d4 squares in a random direction.

name: Crawling Earth
description: Ground that animates when stepped on, then quiets after a few moments. It grasps at ankles and drags creatures down. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: Earth Grasp
powers.trigger: A creature ends its turn on crawling earth
powers.effect: The ground grasps the creature — DC 14 Athletics or immobilized (save ends). On a failed save while immobilized, the creature is pulled underground and restrained (escape DC 18).

powers.name: Earthen Burial
powers.trigger: A creature is knocked prone on crawling earth
powers.effect: The earth begins to engulf the creature. The creature is restrained (save ends). On the first failed save, the creature begins to suffocate as earth covers it completely. A DC 15 Athletics check as a standard action by an adjacent ally frees the creature.

name: Demon Jags
description: Sharp, rugged stone formed when demons are trampled or violently absorbed into the surrounding surface. Razor-edged and blood-stained. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: Razor Ground
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed, pulled, or slid through demon jags
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d10 damage per square of forced movement through the jags.

powers.name: Jagged Retaliation
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone on demon jags
powers.effect: The sharp stone tears flesh. The creature takes 2d6 damage and ongoing 5 damage (save ends). The creature's movement speed is reduced by 2 until the ongoing damage ends.

name: Demon Slick
description: Odd, vile-smelling slime that makes footing treacherous. Widespread where demons congregate. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: Vile Slip
powers.trigger: A creature charges through demon slick
powers.effect: DC 15 Acrobatics or the creature falls prone, ending the charge. Prone creatures in the slick grant combat advantage and take a −2 to escape checks.

powers.name: Slick Slide
powers.trigger: A creature in demon slick is hit by a push, pull, or slide effect
powers.effect: The forced movement increases by 2 squares. If the creature impacts a wall or other creature, both take 1d6 damage.

name: Earth Flow
description: In the Elemental Chaos, earth moves constantly in rivers of rock, dirt, or mud, carrying creatures along or burying them. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: River Drag
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the earth flow
powers.effect: The creature is slid 2 squares in the flow's direction. If this moves the creature into a wall or off an edge, it takes 1d10 damage.

powers.name: Rock Wave
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The earth flow surges. Each creature in the flow must succeed on an Athletics check (moderate DC) or be knocked prone and carried 2 squares in the direction of the flow.

name: Elemental Spout
description: Eruptions of material or elemental energy issuing forth from solid surfaces, bodies of liquid, raging storms, or empty air. (The Plane Below p.13)

powers.name: Elemental Blast
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The spout erupts: burst 2, 2d6 damage of the spout's element (GM determines fire/cold/lightning/acid). DC 14 Reflex for half.

powers.name: Geysir Backlash
powers.trigger: A creature attempts to block or plug an elemental spout
powers.effect: The spout builds pressure and erupts violently. Burst 1 centered on the spout; each creature takes 2d8 damage of the spout's element type and is pushed 3 squares. The spout is active for 1 additional round.

name: Energy Alteration Field
description: The air sparkles and the ground buzzes in chaotic energy alteration fields, transforming one damage type into another. (The Plane Below p.15)

powers.name: Type Conversion
powers.trigger: A power with a damage type keyword is used in the field
powers.effect: Roll 1d6: 1-2 the damage type changes to fire, 3-4 to cold, 5-6 to lightning. This can benefit or harm the attacker depending on the target's resistances.

powers.name: Resistance Inversion
powers.trigger: A creature with energy resistance enters the field
