powers.effect: The creature's highest energy resistance is converted to vulnerability 5 of that type until it leaves the field. The creature is unaware of this change until it takes damage of that type.

name: Frozen Fire
description: Portions of the Elemental Chaos experience cold so intense that even fire freezes, forming a highly unstable substance. (The Plane Below p.15)

powers.name: Unstable Thaw
powers.trigger: A fire power is used within 3 squares
powers.effect: The frozen fire melts, releasing energy: burst 2, 2d6 fire and cold damage (DC 15 Reflex for half). The substance is destroyed.

powers.name: Thaw Burst
powers.trigger: A fire attack targets a square of frozen fire
powers.effect: The frozen fire thaws violently. Burst 2; each creature takes 2d6 fire and cold damage. The squares become difficult terrain (melted slush) for the rest of the encounter.

name: Ice Maws
description: Expanses of permafrost that come alive with mouthlike openings, snapping shut on creatures that step on them. (The Plane Below p.15)

powers.name: Snapping Jaw
powers.trigger: A creature enters an ice maw square
powers.effect: The maw snaps shut: 2d6 cold damage and the creature is restrained (escape DC 15 Athletics). If not escaped by end of next turn, 1d10 cold damage.

powers.name: Ice Jaw Crush
powers.trigger: A creature is restrained by an ice maw at the start of its turn
powers.effect: The maw tightens. The creature takes 1d10 cold damage and must succeed on a saving throw or be stunned until the end of its next turn. An adjacent ally can free the creature with a DC 17 Athletics check.

name: Infectious Pallor
description: Pockets of diseased air that drift through the Abyss, sickening and weakening all who breathe them. (The Plane Below p.16)

powers.name: Plague Cloud
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the pallor
powers.effect: DC 14 Fortitude or the creature is weakened and takes ongoing 5 poison damage (save ends both). A creature that saves is immune for 1 round.

powers.name: Spreading Infection
powers.trigger: A creature fails its save against the pallor's weakened effect
powers.effect: Each creature adjacent to the affected creature must make a saving throw or also contract the disease, becoming weakened (save ends).

name: Lightning Mist
description: Fields of gray-blue fog that drift slowly through the Elemental Chaos, hazardous to traverse quickly — crackling with static. (The Plane Below p.16)

powers.name: Static Discharge
powers.trigger: A creature moves more than 3 squares through the mist on its turn
powers.effect: The creature takes 2d6 lightning damage and each creature adjacent to it takes 1d6 lightning damage.

powers.name: Static Chain
powers.trigger: Two or more creatures wearing metal armor are within the mist
powers.effect: Lightning arcs between them. Each armored creature takes 1d8 lightning damage and the space between them becomes charged until the end of the round, dealing 5 lightning damage to anyone crossing it.

name: Liquid Thunder
description: Highly volatile liquid pools coalesced from the force of a powerful elemental storm. Detonates on impact. (The Plane Below p.16)

powers.name: Thunder Detonation
powers.trigger: A creature enters a liquid thunder pool or the pool is struck
powers.effect: Burst 2: 2d8 thunder damage (DC 15 Reflex for half) and each creature is deafened (save ends). The pool is consumed.

powers.name: Thunder Wave
powers.trigger: A creature disturbs a pool of liquid thunder (entering or attacking in it)
powers.effect: A concussive wave radiates outward. Each creature within 3 squares must succeed on a Fortitude save or be deafened and take a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

name: Phase Crystal
description: Translucent silvery crystal that can discharge extradimensional energy and shunt a creature out of phase for a short time. (The Plane Below p.17)

powers.name: Phase Pulse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature within burst 2 of a phase crystal is phased until end of its next turn (insubstantial, can pass through walls, cannot be opportunity attacked).

powers.name: Phase Shunt
powers.trigger: A creature within 2 squares of phase crystal makes an attack
powers.effect: The crystal pulses, momentarily phasing the target partially out of reality. The target gains insubstantial until the start of its next turn but also cannot make opportunity attacks.

name: Primordial Font
description: Volatile fountains of liquid elemental energy that change those who bathe in them — granting power at a cost. (The Plane Below p.17)

powers.name: Elemental Baptism
powers.trigger: A creature enters the font
powers.effect: Roll 1d4: 1=resist 5 fire, 2=resist 5 cold, 3=resist 5 lightning, 4=resist 5 acid. Lasts until end of encounter. The creature also takes 1d8 damage of the same type. Each creature can benefit only once.

powers.name: Elemental Transformation
powers.trigger: A creature bathes in the primordial font as a standard action
powers.effect: The creature gains one of: resist 10 fire, resist 10 cold, or fly speed 6 (altitude limit 2) until the end of the encounter. However, the creature also gains vulnerable 5 to the opposite element.

name: Strangling Wind
description: Wind pressure so great and blasts so turbulent that it slows and even suffocates those who push themselves too hard. (The Plane Below p.17)

powers.name: Suffocating Gale
powers.trigger: A creature runs or charges in the wind
powers.effect: The creature loses a healing surge at the end of its turn. If no surges remain, it is weakened until end of next turn.

powers.name: Suffocation Vortex
powers.trigger: A creature starts its third consecutive turn in strangling wind
powers.effect: The creature begins to suffocate. It is dazed and takes ongoing 10 damage (save ends both). Leaving the strangling wind area allows an immediate saving throw with a +5 bonus.

name: Wrath Mud
description: Eerie mud that saps sanity from creatures within it, pushing them to violence through psychic pain. (The Plane Below p.17)

powers.name: Psychic Agony
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in wrath mud
powers.effect: 1d6 psychic damage and the creature must use at least one attack on its turn or take 1d6 additional psychic damage.

powers.name: Psychic Explosion
powers.trigger: A creature in wrath mud is reduced to 0 hit points
powers.effect: The psychic energy in the mud detonates. Close burst 2; each creature takes 2d6 psychic damage and must make a saving throw or use a free action to make a melee basic attack against the nearest ally.

name: Armorfields
description: Where Moradin's exalted tread, armorfields spring up — ground that hardens and protects those who stand upon it. (The Plane Above p.50)

powers.name: Armored Ground
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on armorfields
powers.effect: The creature gains +1 to AC and Fortitude until end of its turn.

powers.name: Protective Surge
powers.trigger: A creature on armorfields is hit by a critical hit
powers.effect: The armorfields absorb part of the blow. The critical hit is downgraded to a normal hit, and the creature gains +2 to AC until the end of its next turn.
powers.recharge: Recharges when no creature on the armorfields is bloodied

name: Brainswell Nebula
description: Gigantic cloud formations resembling a diseased, pulsating brain, often encountered in githyanki-controlled sectors of the Astral Sea. (The Plane Above p.28)

powers.name: Psychic Squall
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature in the area takes 1d8 psychic damage and is dazed until end of its next turn (DC 15 Will negates daze).

powers.name: Psychic Feedback
powers.trigger: A creature uses a power with the Psychic keyword in the nebula
powers.effect: The nebula amplifies the psychic energy. The attack deals 1d8 extra psychic damage but the attacker takes 5 psychic damage from the feedback.

name: Carpet of Serpents
description: Swarms of serpents or other venomous creatures that dart in and out of hidden dens, striking exposed ankles. (The Plane Above p.86)

powers.name: Serpent Strike
powers.trigger: A creature enters a serpent square
powers.effect: 1d8 poison damage and ongoing 5 poison damage (save ends). The creature is slowed as serpents coil around its legs.

powers.name: Serpent Tangle
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone in the carpet of serpents
powers.effect: Serpents swarm over the creature. It is restrained (save ends) and takes ongoing 5 poison damage (save ends both). While restrained, the creature takes a −2 penalty to attack rolls.

name: Chainstorm
description: Phantasmal, shrieking chains — thought to be echoes of an imprisoned deity's rage manifesting in the Astral Sea. (The Plane Above p.29)

powers.name: Phantom Chain Lash
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature in the area: +12 vs. Reflex, 1d10 damage and the creature is immobilized until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Chain Binding
powers.trigger: A creature is hit by a phantom chain lash and is already slowed
powers.effect: The chains wrap tighter. The creature is restrained (save ends) instead of slowed. While restrained, each attempt to teleport requires a saving throw; on failure, the teleport fails.

name: Chaos Spots
description: Certain locations in constant flux — terrain shifts, gravity reverses, and the environment changes unpredictably. (The Plane Above p.109)

powers.name: Reality Hiccup
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: GM rolls 1d6: 1-2=gravity reverses for 1 round, 3-4=all creatures shift 1 square clockwise, 5-6=terrain type in a burst 3 changes (water, fire, ice).

powers.name: Reality Inversion
powers.trigger: A creature uses a healing power in a chaos spot
powers.effect: The chaos spot inverts the healing. The healing is halved, and one random enemy within 5 squares heals for the amount lost. If no enemy is in range, the healing works normally.

name: Choking Vapors
description: Fumes rising from volcanic vents that choke and blind creatures, restricting movement and visibility. (The Plane Above p.86)

powers.name: Volcanic Choke
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the vapors
powers.effect: 1d6 fire and poison damage. The creature cannot speak or use verbal components until end of its turn (DC 14 Fortitude negates the silence).

powers.name: Vapor Explosion
powers.trigger: A fire attack is used in the vapors
powers.effect: The vapors ignite. Burst 3 centered on the fire attack's target; each creature takes 2d6 fire damage and is blinded for 1 round. The vapors clear from the affected area for 2 rounds.

name: Cursed Obelisk
description: Black stone obelisks usually covered in runes that radiate curses, weakening or hindering those nearby. (The Plane Above p.87)

powers.name: Curse Pulse
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature within burst 3 of the obelisk takes a −2 penalty to saving throws until end of its next turn (DC 15 Will negates).

powers.name: Curse Transference
powers.trigger: A creature touches the obelisk voluntarily as a standard action
powers.effect: The creature can transfer one save-ends effect to an enemy within 5 squares (the enemy makes a saving throw to resist). On a successful transfer, the creature takes 5 necrotic damage.

name: Despond's Draining Waters
description: The Lake of Despond has a diminishing effect upon living creatures that touch it, sapping strength and will. (The Plane Above p.69)

powers.name: Draining Touch
powers.trigger: A creature enters or starts its turn in the water
powers.effect: The creature loses 1 healing surge. If no surges remain, 1d10 necrotic damage. The creature is also slowed until end of turn.

powers.name: Despair Current
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in the water while bloodied
powers.effect: The creature takes a −2 penalty to all saving throws until the end of its next turn. If the creature is also weakened, it is instead dazed until it leaves the water.

name: Devouring Cloud
description: A chittering cloud of bright-red astral beetles that swarm and devour anything organic in their path. (The Plane Above p.29)

powers.name: Beetle Storm
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn engulfed by the cloud
powers.effect: 2d6 damage, ongoing 5 damage (save ends), and the creature grants combat advantage as beetles cover its eyes.

powers.name: Swarm Frenzy
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature enters or starts its turn in the devouring cloud
powers.effect: The beetles concentrate on the wounded host. The creature takes 2d6 damage instead of the normal cloud damage, and each creature adjacent to it takes 5 damage from beetles scattering outward.

name: Drainer Lichen
description: The Foothills' rockier slopes are mottled by drainer lichen — vegetation that drains life from those who touch it. (The Plane Above p.50)

powers.name: Life Drain Touch
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn adjacent to drainer lichen
powers.effect: 1d6 necrotic damage and a -1 penalty to Fortitude defense until end of next turn.

powers.name: Lichen Spread
powers.trigger: A creature takes damage from drainer lichen
powers.effect: The lichen rapidly grows toward the wounded creature. One adjacent square also becomes covered in drainer lichen. If the creature is prone, two adjacent squares become covered instead.

name: Earthen Maw
description: Parts of the broken badlands open and close like jaws, seeking to snare passersby and drag them underground. (The Plane Above p.87)

powers.name: Ground Snap
powers.trigger: A creature enters an earthen maw square
powers.effect: The maw bites: 2d6 damage and the creature is restrained (escape DC 16). At the start of the creature's next turn while restrained, the maw deals 1d10 damage.

powers.name: Swallow Whole
powers.trigger: A creature is restrained by an earthen maw at the start of its turn
powers.effect: The maw closes around the creature. The creature takes 2d8 damage and is removed from play (buried). It can escape with two consecutive successful Athletics checks (hard DC) as standard actions. An ally can dig as a standard action to grant a +2 bonus.

name: Gramble
description: A dense, thorny bush with carnivorous instincts covering the rugged heaths of the Foothills. (The Plane Above p.50)

powers.name: Thorny Grasp
powers.trigger: A creature enters a gramble square
powers.effect: 1d6 damage and the creature is immobilized until end of its turn. If forced into gramble, the damage increases to 2d6.

powers.name: Carnivorous Bite
powers.trigger: A creature takes damage from gramble's thorns while bloodied
powers.effect: The gramble senses blood and clamps down. The creature takes an additional 1d8 damage and is slowed (save ends) as the thorns dig deeper.

name: Grasping Vines
description: Vines, roots, and vegetation infused with aberrant energies that entangle those who come near. (The Plane Above p.107)

powers.name: Vine Snare
powers.trigger: A creature enters or starts its turn in vine squares
powers.effect: The creature is restrained (escape DC 14 Athletics). While restrained, the vines deal 1d6 damage at the start of each turn.

powers.name: Vine Drag
powers.trigger: A creature fails its first save against vine snare's restrained condition
powers.effect: The vines pull the creature 1 square deeper into the vine patch and the creature takes 5 damage. Each subsequent failed save moves the creature 1 additional square.

name: Insect Swarms
description: Swarms of biting, sucking insects drawn by fresh blood and looking for their next source of food. (The Plane Above p.107)

powers.name: Swarm Attack
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature enters or starts its turn in a swarm square
powers.effect: 1d8 damage, ongoing 5 (save ends), and the creature takes −2 to attack rolls until end of turn.

powers.name: Swarm Scatter
powers.trigger: A close burst or close blast attack hits in the swarm's area
powers.effect: The surviving insects scatter. Two new 1-square swarm zones appear in random unoccupied squares within 3 squares. Each new zone inflicts the swarm's normal effects.

name: Mask of Zorthos
description: A Gargantuan phantasmal clay mask — believed to be the hollowed-out head of Zorthos, the slain god of doubt — spinning endlessly through the Astral Sea. (The Plane Above p.29)

powers.name: Doubt Aura
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn within 5 squares of the mask
powers.effect: DC 15 Will or the creature cannot use daily powers until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Gaze of Madness
powers.trigger: A creature within 5 squares of the Mask fails a Will save by 5 or more
powers.effect: The creature is dominated (save ends). While dominated, the creature uses its most powerful available attack against the nearest ally on its turn.

name: Mercyfields
description: Locations visited by Bahamut's exalted dragons develop into mercyfields — ground that heals and shelters the wounded. (The Plane Above p.51)

powers.name: Merciful Ground
powers.trigger: A creature drops to 0 HP or fewer on mercyfields
powers.effect: The creature instead drops to 1 HP. This can happen only once per creature per encounter.

powers.name: Dragon's Respite
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature ends its turn on mercyfields
powers.effect: The creature gains temporary hit points equal to half its level + 5. Chromatic dragons instead take 5 radiant damage.

name: Nihilath Shroud
description: A roiling wave of gray ectoplasmic matter continually sprouting tentacles that pull and tear at each other before reabsorbing. (The Plane Above p.29)

powers.name: Tentacle Lash
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Tentacles reach out — each creature within burst 3: +13 vs. Reflex, 1d10 damage and pulled 2 squares toward the shroud's center.

powers.name: Shroud Engulf
powers.trigger: A creature is pulled into the center of the nihilath shroud
powers.effect: The ectoplasmic matter engulfs the creature. It is blinded, deafened, and restrained (save ends all). While engulfed, the creature takes ongoing 10 damage. An adjacent ally can pull the creature free with a DC 20 Athletics check.

name: Pocket of Night
description: In the darkest places, shadows have unnatural weight and no natural light can penetrate the darkness. (The Plane Above p.87)

powers.name: Deepening Dark
powers.trigger: A light source enters the pocket
powers.effect: The light is extinguished. The creature holding it takes 1d6 psychic damage as darkness presses in. Darkvision is reduced to 2 squares within the pocket.

powers.name: Shadow Drain
powers.trigger: A creature uses a power with the Radiant keyword in the pocket of night
powers.effect: The shadows absorb the light. The radiant damage is halved, and the pocket of night expands by 1 square in all directions for 1 round.

name: Psychic Storm
description: Psychic storms darken the astral clouds and reach the size of earthly hurricanes, assaulting minds. (The Plane Above p.29)

powers.name: Mind Blast
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: Each creature in the area takes 2d6 psychic damage and is stunned until end of its next turn (DC 16 Will: half damage and dazed instead of stunned).

powers.name: Storm Surge
powers.trigger: A creature is hit by the mind blast and fails its save by 5 or more
powers.effect: The psychic storm intensifies around the creature. It is stunned (save ends) and projects its pain — each creature adjacent to it takes 5 psychic damage at the start of its turns.

name: Sehil's Guts
description: A Huge phantasmal knot of blood-red tubes — remains of the intestines of Sehil, a primordial that Kord slew barehanded. (The Plane Above p.29)

powers.name: Visceral Pulse
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn within 3 squares
powers.effect: 1d6 psychic damage and the creature grants combat advantage until end of its turn as revulsion overwhelms focus.

powers.name: Digestive Trap
powers.trigger: A creature enters a square occupied by Sehil's Guts
powers.effect: The tubes attempt to engulf the creature. Level + 3 vs. Reflex; hit: the creature is restrained and takes ongoing 10 acid damage (save ends both). Miss: the creature is slowed until the end of its next turn.

name: Soul Venom
description: Areas containing tainted atmosphere that poisons the soul as much as the body. (The Plane Above p.87)

powers.name: Spiritual Poison
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in soul venom
powers.effect: 1d6 poison and necrotic damage. The creature cannot benefit from temporary HP until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Spirit Decay
powers.trigger: A creature fails two consecutive saves against soul venom
powers.effect: The creature's soul begins to unravel. It loses one healing surge for the rest of the encounter. If it has no healing surges remaining, it takes 2d10 necrotic damage instead.

name: Soulshocked Ground
description: Patches of ground infused with psychic residue to keep arena fights bloody — drives combatants to greater ferocity. (The Plane Above p.115)

powers.name: Arena Fury
powers.trigger: A creature bloodies an enemy while on soulshocked ground
powers.effect: The creature can make a melee basic attack as a free action against a different target within reach.

powers.name: Bloodlust Pulse
powers.trigger: A creature scores a killing blow on soulshocked ground
powers.effect: The ground surges with psychic energy. The creature gains +2 to attack rolls and +5 temporary hit points until the end of its next turn, but must charge or attack the nearest creature on its next turn if able.

name: Valorfields
description: When Kord's exalted gather to fight, they leave valorfields in their wake — ground that empowers martial prowess. (The Plane Above p.51)

powers.name: Warrior's Might
powers.trigger: A creature hits with a melee attack while on valorfields
powers.effect: The creature gains 5 temporary hit points and can push the target 1 extra square.

powers.name: Kord's Challenge
powers.trigger: A creature on valorfields uses an action point
powers.effect: The valorfields surge with energy. The creature gains +2 to attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of its next turn. Additionally, the creature must target the most powerful enemy it can see with its extra action.

name: Venomous Air
description: Clouds of nigh-undetectable poisons that hang in the air and amplify other poison attacks. (The Plane Above p.87)

powers.name: Venom Amplification
powers.trigger: A creature takes poison damage while in venomous air
powers.effect: The poison damage increases by 1d6 and any ongoing poison damage increases by 2.

powers.name: Toxin Saturation
powers.trigger: A creature takes poison damage while in the venomous air
powers.effect: The ambient venom amplifies the poison. The creature takes an additional 5 poison damage and the save DC against any ongoing poison effects increases by 2 until the end of the encounter.

name: Combustibles
description: Treasures like paper, scrolls, and precious wood that are flammable and can go up in flames during battle. (Draconomicon p.60)

powers.name: Spreading Fire
powers.trigger: A fire attack hits within 2 squares of combustibles
powers.effect: The combustibles ignite: burst 1, 1d8 fire damage (DC 12 Reflex for half). Fire spreads to adjacent combustible squares next round.

powers.name: Inferno Chain
powers.trigger: Burning combustibles spread to an adjacent square of combustibles
powers.effect: The new fire erupts violently. Each creature within 1 square of the newly burning area takes 1d8 fire damage. The fire continues to spread on subsequent rounds unless extinguished.

name: Dazzling Treasure
description: A mirror, shield, or shiny surface that reflects and intensifies light, temporarily blinding those nearby. (Draconomicon p.60)

powers.name: Blinding Glare
powers.trigger: A bright light source or radiant power activates within 3 squares
powers.effect: Burst 2: each creature must succeed on DC 14 Fortitude or be blinded until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Mirror Redirect
powers.trigger: A creature uses a ranged attack while blinded by dazzling treasure
powers.effect: The attack is reflected in a random direction. Roll 1d8 to determine direction; the attack targets the nearest creature in that direction using the original attack roll.

name: Distracting Prisoner
description: A dragon's charisma and terror can unravel its prisoners' minds. These fools might hamper or distract would-be rescuers. (Draconomicon p.60)

powers.name: Desperate Plea
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The prisoner cries for help. Each PC within 5 squares must succeed on DC 14 Will or grant combat advantage until end of next turn as attention splits.

powers.name: Hostage Shield
powers.trigger: A creature targets the dragon with a ranged or area attack while an adjacent prisoner is alive
powers.effect: The dragon can shift the prisoner into the attack's path as an immediate interrupt. The prisoner takes the hit instead, and the attacker takes a −2 penalty to attack rolls until the end of its next turn from guilt or hesitation.

name: Dragon-Cursed Treasure
description: Treasures carrying their owner's maliciousness — anyone who handles them falls under a mild curse. (Draconomicon p.61)

powers.name: Malicious Curse
powers.trigger: A creature picks up or handles cursed treasure
powers.effect: DC 15 Will or the creature takes −2 to all defenses until end of encounter. If a creature with this curse drops to 0 HP, the curse spreads to the nearest ally within 5 squares.

powers.name: Hoard's Revenge
powers.trigger: A creature picks up or handles dragon-cursed treasure for the second time
powers.effect: The curse deepens. The creature takes a −2 penalty to all defenses (save ends). On the first failed save, the penalty increases to −4 and the creature is also slowed.

name: Shifting Piles and Slippery Coins
description: Loose coins that create unstable footing. Moving through them risks falling or sliding. (Draconomicon p.61)

powers.name: Coin Slide
powers.trigger: A creature moves more than 3 squares through coin piles
powers.effect: DC 14 Acrobatics or the creature falls prone and slides 1d4 squares downhill. Adjacent creatures hear the clattering (Stealth checks in the area fail automatically).

powers.name: Coin Avalanche
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed or falls into a large pile of coins
powers.effect: The pile collapses. Each creature within 2 squares must succeed on an Acrobatics check (moderate DC) or fall prone and be buried (restrained, save ends). Buried creatures have concealment but cannot see.

name: Vicious Treasure
description: Caches containing weapons, armor, and other sharp objects that can snag and cut the unwary. (Draconomicon p.61)

powers.name: Hidden Blade
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone in vicious treasure
powers.effect: The creature takes 1d8 damage from concealed weapons and takes ongoing 5 damage (save ends) as blades tear flesh.

powers.name: Trapped Cache
powers.trigger: A creature searches vicious treasure carelessly (no Thievery check)
powers.effect: A spring-loaded blade or hidden spike attacks: Level + 5 vs. AC; hit: 2d6 damage and ongoing 5 damage (save ends). On a Thievery check (hard DC), the trap is found and safely disarmed.

name: Ash Field
description: Defiling magic withers verdant areas, dissolving plants into fine powder and creating extended areas of lifeless ash. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.34)

powers.name: Choking Ash
powers.trigger: A creature moves through an ash field
powers.effect: The creature must succeed on DC 14 Endurance or be slowed and take −2 to attack rolls until end of its next turn as ash fills lungs.

powers.name: Ash Storm
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10 when wind is present
powers.effect: A swirl of choking ash fills a burst 2 area. Each creature in the burst is blinded until the end of its next turn and takes 5 damage. The cloud persists until the start of the next round, providing concealment.

name: Barbed Cacti
description: Cacti with wicked hooks that cling to a creature's flesh, damaging and slowing those who brush against them. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.34)

powers.name: Barbed Hook
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed into barbed cacti
powers.effect: 1d10 damage and the creature is immobilized as barbs dig in (escape DC 14 Athletics; escaping deals 1d6 additional damage).

powers.name: Cactus Spray
powers.trigger: A creature destroys a barbed cactus (attacks it or pushes another creature through it)
powers.effect: The cactus ruptures. Each creature within 1 square takes 1d6 damage and ongoing 5 poison damage (save ends) from the cactus's toxic sap.

name: Black Sand
description: When defiling magic is used to slaughter innocents, a residue mixes with the ground to create black sand that drains life. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.34)

powers.name: Defiling Drain
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on black sand
powers.effect: The creature loses 1 healing surge. If no surges remain, 1d8 necrotic damage. Vegetation in burst 2 withers and dies.

powers.name: Defiling Surge
powers.trigger: A creature with the Arcane power source uses a daily power on black sand
powers.effect: The black sand amplifies the defiling energy. The power deals 1d10 extra necrotic damage, but each ally within 3 squares takes 5 necrotic damage as life energy is torn away.

name: Brambleweed
description: Brambleweed has finger-length thorns, sharp and sturdy enough to rend flesh. It tangles and tears. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.34)

powers.name: Thorn Tangle
powers.trigger: A creature enters a brambleweed square
powers.effect: 1d6 damage and the creature is slowed (save ends). If already slowed, it is immobilized instead.

powers.name: Tumbleweed Rush
powers.trigger: Strong wind or a push effect sends brambleweed rolling
powers.effect: The brambleweed tumbles 1d4 squares in the wind direction. Each creature in its path: Level + 3 vs. Reflex; hit: 1d8 damage and the creature is slowed until the end of its next turn.

name: Dead Magic
description: The most powerful arcane magic completely drains an area of plant and animal life, leaving a dead magic zone. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.35)

powers.name: Power Void
powers.trigger: A creature enters the dead magic zone
powers.effect: Encounter and daily powers cannot be used in the zone. At-will powers function normally. Magic items provide no bonuses.

powers.name: Magic Backlash
powers.trigger: A creature attempts to use a power with the Arcane keyword in dead magic terrain
powers.effect: The power functions at half effect (half damage, half duration). The caster takes 5 psychic damage from the strain of forcing magic through dead terrain.

name: Defiled Terrain
description: Terrain created by the use of powerful defiling magic — withered, lifeless ground that saps vitality. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.34)

powers.name: Withering Touch
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn on defiled terrain
powers.effect: The creature takes 5 necrotic damage and cannot regain HP by any means until end of its next turn.

powers.name: Ash Revenant
powers.trigger: A creature dies on defiled terrain
powers.effect: At the end of the round, the corpse crumbles to ash and an ash wraith minion rises in its square. The wraith acts on initiative count 0 and attacks the nearest living creature. It lasts until destroyed or until the end of the encounter.

name: Glimmering Mirage
description: Crafted by cruel primal spirits to confuse and distress wanderers with false visions of oases and shelter. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.35)

powers.name: False Oasis
powers.trigger: A creature moves toward the mirage
powers.effect: DC 15 Insight or the creature must spend its move action moving toward the mirage. On reaching it, the illusion vanishes and the creature grants combat advantage until end of next turn.

powers.name: Desert Madness
powers.trigger: A creature spends two consecutive turns pursuing a mirage
powers.effect: The creature is dazed (save ends) from heat exhaustion and mental strain. While dazed from this effect, ranged attacks against the creature gain +2 to hit as it stumbles unpredictably.

name: Lightning Pillar
description: A pillar humming with elemental power — clearly an otherworldly formation that arcs lightning at those nearby. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.35)

powers.name: Pillar Arc
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: The pillar discharges: burst 3, 2d8 lightning damage (DC 15 Reflex for half). Creatures in metal armor take +1d8 extra damage.

powers.name: Conducted Strike
powers.trigger: A creature wearing metal armor moves within 2 squares of the pillar
powers.effect: Lightning leaps from the pillar: Level + 3 vs. Reflex; hit: 2d8 lightning damage and the creature is pulled 1 square toward the pillar. The pillar's next arc discharge deals 1d8 extra damage.

name: Mudflats
description: Underground water reservoirs seep through the soil to create a dusty sludge that hampers movement. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.35)

powers.name: Sinking Muck
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn in mudflats
powers.effect: DC 12 Athletics or the creature is slowed until end of turn. Two consecutive failures: immobilized instead (escape DC 14).

powers.name: Mud Eruption
powers.trigger: A creature moves more than 3 squares through mudflats in a single turn
powers.effect: The creature's movement churns up a burst of sludge. Each creature adjacent to the moving creature at the end of the move is blinded until the end of its next turn.

name: Psychic Reservoir
description: Odd violet crystals growing in caverns or rocky terrain, containing latent psychic energy that assaults the mind. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.36)

powers.name: Psionic Burst
powers.trigger: A creature with an Intelligence of 12+ starts its turn within 2 squares
powers.effect: 1d8 psychic damage and the creature is dazed until end of its turn (DC 14 Will negates daze).

powers.name: Psionic Resonance
powers.trigger: A creature with a power that has the Psychic keyword ends its turn adjacent to the reservoir
powers.effect: The crystals harmonize with the creature's mind. The creature's next psychic attack deals 1d10 extra damage, but on a miss, the backlash deals 5 psychic damage to the attacker.

name: Rocky Badlands
description: Rugged, arid canyons and wastes with precarious footing, hidden drops, and ambush positions. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.36)

powers.name: Crumbling Edge
powers.trigger: A creature is pushed to within 1 square of a ledge
powers.effect: DC 14 Acrobatics or the creature falls 1d4 × 10 feet, taking falling damage.

powers.name: Canyon Ambush
powers.trigger: A creature on high ground in the badlands attacks a creature below
powers.effect: The attacker gains +2 to the attack roll and can push the target 1 square as rocks are dislodged by the attack. If the target is pushed into a wall, it takes 5 extra damage.

name: Salt Flats
description: Bleak plains encrusted with saline deposits and bone-dry sand. The glaring white surface blinds and disorients. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.36)

powers.name: Blinding Glare
powers.trigger: A creature without eye protection starts its turn on salt flats during daylight
powers.effect: The creature is blinded until end of its turn (DC 12 Endurance negates). Attacks from outside the flats targeting creatures on the flats take a −2 penalty.

powers.name: Salt Burn
powers.trigger: A bloodied creature falls prone on salt flats
powers.effect: Salt enters the creature's wounds. The creature takes 5 damage and takes a −2 penalty to saving throws against ongoing damage effects until it is no longer bloodied.

name: Sandy Wastes
description: Featureless stretches of sand, wind, and relentless heat. Soft ground slows movement and obscures tracks. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.36)

powers.name: Sand Vortex
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10
powers.effect: A dust devil forms: burst 2 (GM places), each creature is pushed 1d4 squares and blinded until end of next turn (DC 14 Fortitude negates blindness).

powers.name: Sandstorm Surge
powers.trigger: Initiative count 10 when wind is present
powers.effect: Blinding sand sweeps the battlefield. Each creature without cover must succeed on a Fortitude save or be blinded and slowed until the end of its next turn. Creatures with a head covering gain +5 to the save.

name: Sickening Heat
description: The sun burns with peculiar intensity in areas where magic has defiled plant life, causing exhaustion and delirium. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.35)

powers.name: Heat Stroke
powers.trigger: A creature takes a standard action and a move action on the same turn in sickening heat
powers.effect: DC 15 Endurance or the creature is dazed until end of its next turn and takes 1d6 fire damage.

powers.name: Sunstroke
powers.trigger: A creature in heavy armor starts its third consecutive turn in sickening heat
powers.effect: The creature is weakened (save ends). On a failed save, the creature also takes ongoing 5 fire damage. Removing armor (standard action) ends the weakened condition immediately.

name: Silt Pool
description: Natural dips filled with extremely light, powdery silt that acts like quicksand, swallowing creatures who step in. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.36)

powers.name: Silt Swallow
powers.trigger: A creature enters a silt pool
powers.effect: The creature sinks: slowed on round 1, immobilized on round 2, restrained on round 3 (escape DC 16 Athletics). Restrained creatures begin suffocating.

powers.name: Silt Lung
powers.trigger: A creature submerged in the silt pool fails its save against restrained
powers.effect: The creature begins to suffocate. It is dazed (save ends). On a second failed save, the creature is stunned (save ends) and begins dying at the end of its next turn unless freed.

name: Slipsand
description: Ground saturated with glass particles from heavy magic use. The surface is treacherously slick and abrasive. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.37)

powers.name: Glass Slide
powers.trigger: A creature charges or runs on slipsand
powers.effect: DC 15 Acrobatics or the creature falls prone and slides 2d4 squares, taking 1d6 damage from abrasion. Difficult terrain for all movement.

powers.name: Glass Shrapnel
powers.trigger: A creature falls prone on slipsand
powers.effect: Glass particles cut into exposed skin. The creature takes 1d6 damage and ongoing 5 damage (save ends). While taking this ongoing damage, the creature leaves a blood trail granting enemies +2 to track it.

name: Tree of Life
description: A tree mystically infused with primal forces of life, sheltering and healing those beneath its canopy. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.37)

powers.name: Life Canopy
powers.trigger: A creature starts its turn under the tree of life
powers.effect: The creature regains 5 HP and gains +2 to saving throws until end of its turn. The tree has AC 5, 100 HP; if destroyed, the area becomes defiled terrain.

powers.name: Branch Shield
powers.trigger: An ally within 2 squares of the Tree of Life is hit by an attack
powers.effect: The tree's branches interpose protectively. The ally gains +4 to AC and Reflex against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, the tree takes 10 damage.

name: Z'Tal Horde
description: Colonies of z'tal lizards gathered in a mass, exuding slippery ooze and noxious vapor. (Dark Sun Creature Catalog p.37)

powers.name: Noxious Swarm
powers.trigger: A creature enters or starts its turn in a z'tal square
powers.effect: 1d6 poison damage and the creature falls prone (DC 12 Reflex negates prone) as slippery ooze and darting lizards trip it.

powers.name: Horde Stampede
powers.trigger: A creature takes fire damage within 3 squares of the z'tal horde
powers.effect: The lizards panic and stampede. Each creature in or adjacent to the horde's squares must succeed on a Reflex save or take 2d6 damage and be knocked prone as the horde scatters. The horde re-forms in a new location at the end of the round.
